messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 PAGER: Dedicated EU inference pool — sudden spike in 502/504 errors across long-polling endpoints (5m rolling). Severity: high for select enterprise routes. Auto-escalation to on-call.

mike_oncall: I'm oncall. Picking this up. Assigning to me and ben. Starting triage — will post ETA for customer comms in 10m.

ben_sre: quick check — seeing gateway 502s from reverse-proxy to runtime on node group eu-dedicated-2b. Error ratio ~14% p95 on the last 5m. Logs show repeated grpc EOF from model-proxy.

ben_sre: logs snippet:
```
2025-06-12T14:11:02Z gateway eu-dedicated-2b proxy: recv EOF from 10.48.5.12: model-proxy connection reset
2025-06-12T14:11:03Z runtime eu-dedicated-2b kernel: kv-cache hit spike, stall 120ms
```

mike_oncall: initial hypothesis: transient connection storm + KV cache pressure. Mitigation plan: 1) Reduce egress keepalive to force re-establish on model-proxy, 2) Temporarily divert high-latency enterprise routes to fallback pool (eu-dedicated-1a), 3) Scale up model-proxy by +2 pods. Executing step 1 and 3 now.

cassie_cs: copying in SableBridge contacts — primary CSM @sophie_csm, SRE lead raj_eng, and support alias support@sablebridge.com. We should prepare a short tailored impact blurb for them.

sophie_csm: thanks — SableBridge has active batch jobs hitting our embeddings route. Impact: some background ingest jobs may retry or queue; interactive user flows may see errors ~10-20% on affected endpoints. They need ETA and a clear remediation note.

raj_eng: confirming their traffic is routed via account route id sb-7702 -> eu-dedicated-2b. If we divert, they will hit eu-dedicated-1a which is compatible (model v1.3, same quant). No config change needed on their side.

mike_oncall: drafting status page + customer message. Posting below for quick review and send.

ben_sre: mitigation step 3 finished — scaled model-proxy +2 pods, health checks passing. Applying traffic diversion (step 2) now.

mike_oncall: diversion applied at 14:17 UTC. Observability: 502 rate dropping to ~3% in last 2m. Continuing to monitor.

cassie_cs: suggested customer-facing blurb (short):
"We are investigating an issue affecting the SableBridge integration in the EU region where a subset of requests may return errors or time out. We have applied routing mitigations to direct traffic to healthy capacity and are seeing error rates decline. No action required on your side; background jobs may retry automatically. Estimated restoration: ~15–30 minutes. We will follow up if anything changes."

mike_oncall: status-page draft (for public/incidents):
```
Title: Partial 5xx errors for Dedicated EU pool
Impact: Some requests to dedicated EU capacity may receive 502/504 errors or timeouts.
Status: Mitigation in progress — traffic diverted to fallback capacity, additional proxy capacity added. Error rates decreasing.
Scope: Affects subset of requests for customers on eu-dedicated-2b (including SableBridge).
ETA: Monitoring — next update in 15m.
```

cassie_cs: internal tailored notify for SableBridge (email/SAM):
"SableBridge ops — Hi team, we observed elevated error rates for requests routed to your eu-dedicated-2b capacity. We've rerouted traffic to fallback capacity and added proxy capacity; error rates are now declining. No changes required on your side. We will continue to monitor and notify once fully resolved. Contact: sophie_csm@sablebridge.com (CSM) or support@sablebridge.com."

ben_sre: current metrics at 14:21 UTC: error rate 2.8% (5m), p95 latency for affected endpoints stable. No evidence of data loss. Root cause still under investigation (connection resets + kv-cache pressure).

mike_oncall: checklist for handoff if needed:
- note mitigation actions taken (diversion + scale)
- current error rate and p95 latency
- affected account list: SableBridge (sb-7702), HorizonPay (hp-3399) — both on eu-dedicated-2b routes
- contact routing: SableBridge -> sophie_csm, support@sablebridge.com; HorizonPay -> account-team (acct-horizon@vendor.com)
- do not change model versions unless directed by eng

sophie_csm: I'll send the tailored email to SableBridge now and post the public status page update once you say stable.

mike_oncall: thanks. I will continue monitoring for 30m. If error rate stays <5% for 15m, we'll mark as mitigated and close. If anyone else sees new regressions, ping me directly.

cassie_cs: sent to SableBridge at 14:23 UTC and cc'd product.

ben_sre: follow-up: we matched increased kernel stall metrics to a recent model-proxy config bump earlier today — rolling back that change in staging to reproduce. Filing a follow-up ticket.

mike_oncall: closing note: at 14:34 UTC error rate held at 1.2% for 10m. Marking as mitigated; creating post-incident follow-up: infra-6229. Cassie/sophie — recommend a short customer wrap-up with the timeline and actions taken.

cassie_cs: will draft wrap-up for SableBridge and link to post-incident RCA when ready. :white_check_mark:
